lead: Retrouvailles is the joy of reuniting with someone after a long time. The French word names this meeting. The chest opens and the face brightens with recognition. Familiarity mixes with the strangeness of time having passed. What was on hold becomes present again.

name: Reverence
lead: Reverence is profound, awe-tinged respect bordering on devotion. The chest fills with warmth and the face softens. You have met something larger than ordinary objects of attention. The quiet posture of respect follows on its own.

name: Reverent fear
lead: Reverent fear is fear mixed with awe before something sacred or vast. The chest holds trembling and lifting together, and the body feels small. You stand before something genuinely greater. The fear is proper to what warrants it.

name: Reverie
lead: Reverie is a dreamy drifting through what was, or what might have been. Attention loosens from the current task and floats through memories and possibilities. The chest is soft and the eyes unfocus. The internal world briefly outshines the external one.

name: Revulsion
lead: Revulsion is violent, physical recoil from something foul. The stomach lurches, the chest contracts, the face pulls back. The body's rejection arrives faster than any conscious decision. The need for separation from the source is immediate.

name: Righteousness
lead: Righteousness is moral certainty that you are in the right. The chest is firm with conviction and the bearing is upright. The certainty operates without doubt or open inquiry. You carry yourself in the shape of your conviction.

name: Rootedness
lead: Rootedness is a grounded, stable feeling of belonging to a place. The chest is settled and the breath deep. The belonging needs no ongoing verification. You know where you stand because you have a place to stand.

name: Rue
lead: Rue is soft, wistful regret for a past action. The chest carries a soft, mournful weight and attention returns to what was. You wish you had acted differently. The regret stays gentle rather than turning to harsh self-condemnation.

name: Sacredness
lead: Sacredness is reverent recognition of something holy or set apart. The chest settles and the body becomes still. The thing or moment registers as different in kind from ordinary existence. The encounter itself elicits the particular respect.

name: Sadness
lead: Sadness is the body's response to loss. Something that mattered is gone or out of reach. Colour drains from the world, the body slows, energy turns inward. It asks for stillness, comes, and goes. It is not depression.

name: Satiety
lead: Satiety is being full, satisfied, requiring nothing more. The body is settled and the mind has reached enough. The fullness is complete in this moment. The satisfaction does not reach for more, and the state can be sustained.

name: Satisfaction
lead: Satisfaction is the settled feeling when needs or desires are met. What was wanted has been received and the wanting quiets. The chest is at ease and the breath full. Nothing needs chasing further at this moment.

name: Saudade
lead: Saudade is melancholic longing for something loved and absent. The Portuguese word names this feeling. The missing runs so deep that it becomes part of the love. Sweetness and pain arrive at once. English approximations each capture only a fraction.

name: Savoring
lead: Savouring is deliberately prolonging and enjoying a good moment. You slow down enough to fully receive what is happening. The chest opens and attention deepens. It needs no new experiences; it works with what is already available.

name: Scepticism
lead: Scepticism is a critical, questioning attitude towards claims. Nothing is accepted at face value; assertions are examined before being believed. The eyes engage with evaluating attention. Commitment is held back until the claim has earned it.

name: Schadenfreude
lead: Schadenfreude is pleasure at someone else's misfortune. The German word names this guilty thrill. The face wants to smile when a rival meets a setback. Few emotions are so widely felt and so little admitted.

name: Scorn
lead: Scorn is open, pointed contempt. You look down on someone. The chest holds cold distance. One corner of the mouth raises with a slight head tilt. The other has been placed beneath consideration, and the placement damages relationships.

name: Security
lead: Security is the calm knowledge that you are safe and provided for. Stable conditions hold you: dependable relationships, sufficient resources, an absence of threat. The chest is full and at rest. Vigilance is not needed, and the body can relax.

name: Self-consciousness
lead: Self-consciousness is hyper-awareness of how others see you. You attend to yourself as you imagine you appear. What you are actually doing fades from view. The chest tightens and the face may flush. The monitoring interferes with natural engagement.

name: Self-doubt
lead: Self-doubt is questioning your own ability or worth. The chest tightens slightly and the breath shallows. Hesitation arises before action, and checking interrupts what would otherwise flow. You wonder whether your judgement can be trusted.

name: Sentimentality
lead: Sentimentality is exaggerated, indulgent tenderness towards the past. The chest swells and the eyes may water. The response exceeds what the circumstances actually warrant. The warm feeling flatters its object beyond what it truly deserves.

name: Serenity
lead: Serenity is gentle, undisturbed calm and quiet contentment. Breathing is slow and easy, and the mind is clear without effort. You rest in yourself, needing nothing to be different. The conditions that produce it are scarce in modern life.

name: Shame
lead: Shame is the feeling that something is wrong with you, not just your actions. The shoulders curl in, the head drops, the impulse is to hide. Guilt says I did a bad thing; shame says I am one. It motivates concealment.

name: Sheepishness
lead: Sheepishness is bashful awareness that you did something foolish. The chest is warm with mild discomfort and the face shows a slight blush. The embarrassment stays mild rather than severe. You remain willing to engage despite the foolish moment.

name: Shock
lead: Shock is abrupt numbness after an overwhelming event. The chest empties and sounds become distant. What happened exceeded the capacity to respond in real time. You keep functioning without being quite present in what is happening.

name: Silliness
lead: Silliness is goofy, lighthearted absurdity that makes you giggle. The chest is light with bubbling energy and the face turns goofy. Absurdity delights rather than confuses. The playful orientation finds genuine pleasure in the wonderfully ridiculous.

name: Smugness
lead: Smugness is self-satisfied superiority that others can sense. The chest is full in a contented way. The face carries a slight knowing smile. The pleasure implies comparison with others. The self-satisfaction shows whether you intend it or not.

name: Sobremesa
lead: Sobremesa is lingering at the table after a meal, talking. The Spanish word names this suspended time. The chest is relaxed and the voice flows easily. The food is finished but no one wants to leave. The conversation is its own reason.

name: Solace
lead: Solace is comfort found in the midst of grief or difficulty. Something or someone softens the pain without erasing it. The chest carries weight but also a receiving. You are met in your suffering by what helps.

name: Solemnity
lead: Solemnity is quiet, serious weightiness befitting an important moment. The chest is full but quiet, the face gravely attentive. Funerals, weddings, and oaths call for this gravity. The significance of the occasion absorbs you without distraction.

name: Solicitous love
lead: Solicitous love is watchful, protective love for someone in your care. The chest is open with watchful care and attention sustains. Deep care combines with active vigilance about their welfare. You carry responsibility for their wellbeing.

name: Solicitude
lead: Solicitude is attentive, caring concern for someone's welfare. The chest is warm with directed attention. You actively consider what they may need or be experiencing. The care supports their situation rather than offering generic warmth.

name: Solidarity
lead: Solidarity is felt unity with others who share a cause. The chest broadens and the shoulders square. You stand with others rather than alone, held by a larger we. Shared purpose becomes a source of strength.

name: Solitude
lead: Solitude is peaceful, chosen aloneness. Not lonely, just alone. No connection is being sought, so there is no scanning for it. The mind has room to spread out without managing others. Creativity, self-knowledge, and depth grow here.

name: Sorrow
lead: Sorrow is deep, sustained sadness, heavier than everyday gloom. The body carries weight, the chest holds a quiet ache, time slows. Life itself feels heavy beyond passing low mood. It sits between ordinary sadness and clinical depression.

name: Spaciousness
lead: Spaciousness is an open, expansive feeling of room to breathe. The chest is open and the breath flows freely. There is room within yourself for whatever is present. Engagement happens easily, without constriction and without any sense of crowding.

name: Spite
lead: Spite is petty desire to harm or upset someone. The chest is tight and the face shows a smug or sour expression. The pleasure comes specifically from upsetting the target, not from any larger gain. Minor harm is wanted for its own sake.

name: Spleen
lead: Spleen is a poetic, refined form of melancholic tedium. The French word names this world-weariness. The chest carries a flat, sustained weight and the world appears in greyed tones. Literary traditions have given the weariness its refined shape.

name: Startle
lead: Startle is a sharp, physical flinch. Your body reacts before your mind. The chest jumps, the shoulders pull up, the breath catches. The response completes before conscious thought can catch up. It happens to you before you decide anything.

name: Steadfastness
lead: Steadfastness is firm, unwavering commitment even under pressure. The chest is solid and the stance grounded. Character holds the commitment, not mere stubbornness. You keep holding to what matters even when the holding itself becomes difficult.

name: Stoicism
lead: Stoicism is enduring difficulty without complaint or visible emotion. The chest holds steady and the face shows little. You carry what must be carried without performing the carrying. Greek and Roman philosophy developed the orientation over centuries.

name: Stubbornness
lead: Stubbornness is rigid refusal to change course, for better or worse. The jaw is set and the chest holds firm. New information, pressure, and argument do not move the position. It can serve as integrity or stand as obstacle.

name: Stuporousness
lead: Stuporousness is dull, dazed inability to think clearly. The mind is dazed and the body unfocused. Thinking cannot organise itself, and the dimness resists effort to clear. The dazed state does not lift through ordinary trying.

name: Sublime
lead: The sublime is terrifying beauty, both overwhelming and magnetic. Something vast or profound exceeds your capacity to take it in. The chest expands and the breath catches. You are drawn toward the very thing that slightly frightens you.

name: Submission
lead: Submission is yielding to another's will. You make yourself smaller. The chest collapses inward and the voice quietens. Your presence contracts to accommodate what is imposed. You give up your stance and receive what is directed at you.

name: Surprise
lead: Surprise is the brief jolt when reality breaks the prediction your brain was running. The eyes widen, the eyebrows lift, the body briefly freezes while the system updates. It lasts only seconds. Then it resolves into another emotion, or into nothing.

name: Suspense
lead: Suspense is the tension of not knowing how something will end. The chest tightens and the breath becomes shallow. Attention fixes on the unresolved outcome. You need to know, and you know that you do not yet know.

name: Suspicion
lead: Suspicion is guarded distrust. Something does not feel right. The chest is closed and the eyes narrow slightly. You watch for what might be hidden. Full engagement is held back until more information becomes available.

name: Sympathy
lead: Sympathy is felt understanding that someone is suffering, with genuine care about their pain. The chest softens and the face responds. You are with them, even from a distance. Unlike empathy, it does not require feeling what they feel.

name: Tarab
lead: Tarab is ecstasy and emotional transport through music. The Arabic word names this state. The chest lifts and the body responds. The music carries you out of ordinary engagement into transport. The ecstasy belongs specifically to musical experience.

name: Tendentiousness
lead: Tendentiousness is a biased, one-sided emotional lean. The mind operates from an established lean toward one side. Balanced engagement is resisted, and opposing views stay unengaged. Emotional commitment and one-sidedness arrive together in the stance.

name: Tenderness
lead: Tenderness is soft, protective gentleness toward someone vulnerable, beloved, or in need of care. The body softens and the hands want to be gentle. The other person feels precious enough that ordinary handling would not do. Careful attention follows.

name: Terror
lead: Terror is paralysing, extreme fear where the mind goes blank. The chest seizes and the limbs may freeze rather than fight or flee. Thought disappears or narrows to a single point. The system records it differently from ordinary fear.

name: Tetchiness
lead: Tetchiness is a snappish, touchy mood, easily set off. The threshold for irritation has lowered and the skin feels prickly. Minor things trigger sharp responses that they would not normally draw. The fuse is shorter than usual.

name: Thrill
lead: Thrill is sharp, exhilarating excitement at risk or novelty. The chest is intensely activated and the body feels alive with arousal. The charge comes from the edge between safety and danger. Ordinary safety cannot produce this particular aliveness.

name: Timidity
lead: Timidity is shy reluctance to act or speak. You shrink back. The chest becomes contained and the body draws inward. You hesitate even when something within you would act. The pull is toward a smaller presence.

name: Torpor
lead: Torpor is sluggish inactivity of body and mind. The limbs feel heavy and the mind is slow. Engagement does not come even when it is warranted. The dullness resists ordinary effort to shift it and does not lift.

name: Torschlusspanik
lead: Torschlusspanik is the fear that time is running out to act. The German word means gate-closing panic, from townspeople rushing the gates at night. The chest tightens and the breath quickens. Windows feel like they are narrowing on major life decisions.

name: Toska
lead: Toska is a deep spiritual anguish without a specific cause. The Russian word names this ache. The chest holds a weighted longing that cannot be traced to circumstances. You yearn for something you cannot name, haunted by a shapeless absence.

name: Transcendence
lead: Transcendence is the rare sense of rising beyond ordinary limits. The body feels lighter and larger than itself, and the boundaries of self loosen. Awareness or identity expands. It resists description because it steps outside the ordinary frame.

name: Trepidation
lead: Trepidation is cautious, trembling hesitation before acting. The chest is tense with apprehension and the body trembles slightly. What lies ahead warrants the caution it receives. You feel the hesitation in the body itself before you step.

name: Trepidity
lead: Trepidity is a trembling, anxious hesitation. The chest trembles with anxious activation and the body hesitates. Proceeding with confidence is not available right now. Anxious uncertainty holds you firmly in place before any move forward.

name: Triumph
lead: Triumph is victory-charged exultation after overcoming something. The chest expands fully and the arms want to rise. The achievement required overcoming substantial obstacles, and the win proves something through itself. The victory demands open expression and celebration.

name: Truculence
lead: Truculence is aggressive, defiant readiness for conflict. The chest is set and the body is hard. Confrontation is preferred over compliance or peaceful engagement. You are primed for conflict rather than for cooperation with anyone present.

name: Trust
lead: Trust is the felt sense that someone or something can be relied on. The body relaxes around them, the chest opens, the breath deepens. It rests on accumulated evidence, not wishing or believing. Social life would be impossible without it.

name: Tsundoku
lead: Tsundoku is buying books and never reading them. The Japanese word names this habit. Pleasure in acquiring meets mild guilt at the unread piles. The love of books exceeds the capacity to read them. Possibility accumulates, perhaps never realised.

name: Turmoil
lead: Turmoil is churning inner chaos, multiple emotions at war. The chest is restless and the breath uneven. No single feeling settles before another rises to displace it. The system holds contradictions it cannot integrate into one response.

name: Ubuntu
lead: Ubuntu is the Southern African concept that I am because we are. Your existence is woven into the existence of others. Personhood arises through community. It is less a passing feeling than a way of being in the world.

name: Unease
lead: Unease is a subtle, low-level sense that something is off. Nothing specific demands attention, yet the body is not at rest. A quiet wariness keeps you from settling fully. The body registers what the mind has not yet articulated.

name: Validation
lead: Validation is the relief and warmth of being seen and approved. The chest opens with the receiving and the breath deepens. Your worth, perspective, or experience is confirmed by another. Being met resolves what was uncertain or unsteady.

name: Vanity
lead: Vanity is excessive concern with your own appearance or status. The chest carries a fragile pride and attention returns repeatedly to self. Self-presentation takes significant time and energy. The concern exceeds appropriate self-care into preoccupation.

name: Veneration
lead: Veneration is formal, ceremonial respect for what is greater than the self. The chest is open with sustained respect and the bearing is reverent. The respect exceeds ordinary admiration. You stand before something greater and engage it properly.

name: Vengefulness
lead: Vengefulness is the cold desire to pay back a wrong. The chest carries a cold weight. The intention operates patiently, waiting for opportunity rather than acting at once. Payback is held as a just response, carried over time.

name: Vigilance
lead: Vigilance is hyper-alert watchfulness. Every sense is tuned. The chest is poised and the senses sharp. Attention organises around detection, primed to notice what others would miss. The heightened watchful state maintains itself over long stretches.

name: Vindictive intent
lead: Vindictive intent is cold, deliberate intent to wound another in return. The chest is cold with calculation and the mind plans. Hot anger has passed into deliberate planning of harm. The commitment to inflicting return harm is settled.

name: Vindictiveness
lead: Vindictiveness is cold, patient anger that waits to make someone pay. The chest carries a sustained cold weight. Attention returns to the target and to opportunity. The wish is carried over time rather than acted on in heat.

name: Vitality
lead: Vitality is a surge of physical aliveness and energy. The chest is open, the breath full, and the body feels available to itself. You are lit from inside, with energy for what wants doing. The quality is specifically physical.

name: Voorpret
lead: Voorpret is the pleasure of anticipating a fun event. The Dutch word names this advance enjoyment. The chest is light and the mind returns to the event with pleasure. You are lit up before anything has actually happened.

name: Vulnerability
lead: Vulnerability is being open in a way that could be hurt. The chest is unprotected and the mask is down. Something true is shown that could be received well or badly. The body's protection is partially offline by design.

name: Wabi-sabi
lead: Wabi-sabi is finding beauty in imperfection and transience. The Japanese orientation names this quiet appreciation. Weathered, asymmetric, or incomplete things draw a particular response. The imperfection is not just acceptable; it is part of the beauty.

name: Waldeinsamkeit
lead: Waldeinsamkeit is the feeling of being alone in the woods. The German word names this solitude. The chest opens differently here. The breath deepens with the air of the trees. The aloneness is not lonely, because the woods are presence.

name: Wanderlust
lead: Wanderlust is a restless desire to travel and explore. The chest carries restless energy and attention turns toward distant places. What you need feels like it is somewhere else. Life feels incomplete without movement toward the unknown.

name: Warmth
lead: Warmth is a gentle, affectionate glow towards someone or something. The chest is open with mild positive feeling. The face holds a soft smile. The well-wishing makes no demand. Nothing is required from its object in return.

name: Weariness
lead: Weariness is being tired in body and spirit, the effort of going on. The carrying has become its own weight. The chest is heavy and the limbs ask effort to move. You have less than you need, yet must face what is ahead.

name: Weltschmerz
lead: Weltschmerz is world-weariness, sadness about the world's imperfection. The German word names this weight. The heaviness is not about your own life but about the state of things. The grief extends beyond personal circumstances to the larger condition.

name: Whimsy
lead: Whimsy is delightfully odd, fanciful amusement. The chest is light and the mind plays. What is curious and quirky brings particular pleasure. The imaginative engagement does not need things to be ordinary. It delights that they are not.

name: Wistfulness
lead: Wistfulness is a gentle longing for what once was or might have been. The chest holds a soft weight and the gaze turns distant. The sweet ache combines remembered good with its unavailability. Warmth and sadness coexist in the same moment.

name: Woe
lead: Woe is deep, mournful unhappiness. The chest carries a heavy weight and the face is drawn. The sorrow has substantial gravity beyond ordinary sadness. Something significant enough to warrant real mourning has settled in and stays.

name: Wonder
lead: Wonder is captivated curiosity at something mysterious or beautiful. The mind opens, the body becomes still, the breath slightly catches. It does not push toward action of any kind. It asks you to receive rather than respond.

name: Wondrous
lead: Wondrous is being full of open, childlike marvel. The chest is open and lifted, and the eyes widen. You give yourself over to the experience of marvel. The analytical distance adults often keep falls away.

name: Worry
lead: Worry is circling thoughts about a possible problem. The mind returns to the same concern again and again. It hunts for control or solution. The head is busy, the chest tight, the stomach unsettled. The activation stays low but constant.

name: Wrath
lead: Wrath is cold, purposeful, punishing anger. The chest carries a weighted force and the face is grim. The intent to make someone pay has settled into commitment. It moves with control rather than the heat of acute anger.

name: Ya'aburnee
lead: Ya'aburnee is hoping to die before a loved one, to be spared the grief. The Arabic word names what the speaker would prefer. The chest is full with profound love and dread of loss. The love makes the thought of outliving them unbearable.

name: Yearning
lead: Yearning is the intense, aching desire for something just out of reach. The body holds a sustained pull toward what is wanted but not had. It is deeper than a brief wish. The reaching can become part of how a person lives.

name: Zeal
lead: Zeal is fervent, passionate dedication to a cause. The chest is intensely activated with sustained commitment and the body is engaged. The dedication operates with high energy and sustained focus. The fervour sustains substantial engagement over time.

name: Zest
lead: Zest is keen, enthusiastic enjoyment and energy. The body holds bright animation and engagement comes easily. What would feel like effort elsewhere feels pleasurable. You are fully available to life, meeting whatever comes with interest.
